mentions.name: hns
mentions.description: A command-line speech-to-text tool that transcribes the user's voice from the terminal while keeping all data local. The author uses it 5-10 times daily and developer friends have adopted it for daily use. A documentation website with getting-started guides and key use cases, built with Docusaurus, has been published for it.
mentions.audience: Developers who want terminal-based voice transcription with all data kept local
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a docs website [1] for my speech-to-text CLI tool, hns. I use it 5-10 times daily to transcribe my voice, and a few developer friends I've shared it with have also adopted it for daily use. They like that it runs in the terminal and keeps all data local.
